title: Monthly balance sheet reconciliation package
prompt: Prepare a monthly balance sheet reconciliation package with account rollforwards, supporting transactions, aging and unresolved items.
steps: this is a composed size L parent: plan children from recipes R10 (bank reconciliations), R20 (prepaid tie-out), R28 (fixed assets and CIP) and R33; the parent assembles their workbooks and never redoes their work
pull the as-of trial balance for the period and list every balance sheet account with a balance
read the prior month's workpapers from Dime or the standing folder for opening balances
run rollforward per balance sheet account (opening from the prior month, additions, reductions, closing) and write it to the Detail sheet
attach supporting transactions and agings (AR, AP) per account; mark each account reconciled by a child, supported by a schedule, or unresolved
tie the rollforward closings to the trial balance; list unresolved items with the account and what is missing

done.text: The sum of balance sheet closings on the Tie-out equals Dime's trial balance as of the period end
The Detail sheet rolls forward every balance sheet account: opening plus additions less reductions equals closing on every row and the totals row equals the column sums
Every exception row cites the account id and the child workbook, schedule or transaction id behind it
balance-sheet-rec-package.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
Every balance sheet account appears once as reconciled, supported or unresolved; the children's workbooks are referenced, not rebuilt, and an unresolved item says what is missing
